current.lifetimeMeta: Everything in Plus. No renewal, no card on file.
current.earlyAdopterNote: Thank you for being here early. Everything in Plus as it exists today is yours for life. Features we add from here on, and anything that costs us per user to run, belong to the paid plans. Want them? 50% off any plan, forever, applied automatically at checkout.

current.endedMeta: Your data is safe. Pick a plan to keep adding to it.
current.activatingNote: Payment received. Stripe usually confirms within a few seconds.

current.activationUnreachable: We could not reach the server to confirm your payment. Reload the page; if the plan is still missing, contact support.
current.pausedNote: While paused the account is read-only.
current.cancelNote: Changed your mind? Renew in the billing portal and your renewal date stays the same.
